name: phd-transfer-unfinished-phd
description: Policy review 2026-10-03 (P1-transfer-eligibility-c4, DGS: fix as suggested): a student who left a Ph.D. program elsewhere unfinished. The Academic Code’s §4.6 and CSE §5.2 state the six-credit allowance for an unfinished MASTER’S and no figure for an unfinished Ph.D., so the six stays as the conservative default and the §5.2 row says so — the DGS may put the case to the Graduate School (HANDBOOK-REVISIONS §10 item 9). The pre-approved course itself counts as before, pending the Graduate School’s approval.

detailIncludes: 3 of the 6 credits you may transfer are counted
The 6 is this page’s working limit: the Academic Code states six for an unfinished master’s and no figure for an unfinished Ph.D. (Academic Code §4.6)
